body.message:
Thank you for your message. We completely understand your request and appreciate your concern before proceeding with the payment.

Please find our official bank details shared below. Kindly be assured that the payment will be made directly to our company’s official bank account.

Regarding the trade licence and DET/DTCM permit, we apologize but we are unable to share these documents as per our company policy. However, you may verify our company through our official online platforms, where you can find more information about our services as a reputable holiday home operator in Dubai.

If you prefer, you are also welcome to visit our main office and make the payment in person.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
